There is still some doubt on the existence of the suffix*-ḍ-in PK or in Kui; but there is absolutely no doubt about the existence of the suffix*-nḍ-. Therefore, the numerous secondary forms in Kui can be explained as suffixal derivations. The base itself was monosyllabic (*por-, not*pro-), since there is no evidence in Kui for a form like*prōva; therefore, Kuwi_Fporndaliis archaic. This also explains voicening in Kui.
